# marketing-analytics-ai-mcp
# **MCP server for marketing analytics ai mcp operations**

## Install
```bash
pip install marketing-analytics-ai-mcp
```

## Auth & Rate Limits
- Free tier: 10 calls/day. No API key required.
- Pro tier (£79/mo): unlimited + signed attestations.
- Enterprise (£1,499/mo): white-label.
